title: Trigger ambiguity
text: Trigger ambiguity: AC19 presents an exhaustive malformed-list definition but validates only field presence, not value validity. Blank identifiers, labels, descriptions, or evidence sources—and non-integer, negative, or otherwise invalid finding counts—are therefore neither valid nor malformed by the contract. Define the allowed value domains so implementation does not have to guess whether to run the sweep or degrade to non-sweep behavior.
